usage: Harness self-test fixture for the optional checkUpdate adapter operation, not conformance vectors. Each case is an old and a new snapshot of one pinned identity document (records.md §5.5). expected is routine (a monotonic update, which an implementation SHOULD accept without a new trust decision) or owner-decision (any other change, which MUST be presented to the owner).

cases.name: key-added
cases.description: A new key is added; every existing key is unchanged.

cases.name: key-removed
cases.description: An existing key is missing from the new snapshot.

cases.name: public-key-changed
cases.description: An existing key id now has a different publicKeyJwk.

cases.name: purpose-changed
cases.description: An existing key gains a purpose.

cases.name: valid-from-changed
cases.description: An existing key has a different validFrom.

cases.name: valid-until-removed
cases.description: An existing validUntil is removed, which moves it later.

cases.name: address-removed
cases.description: An address listed in the old snapshot is missing from the new one.
